name: Jacob Kenison
bio: Jacob Kenison was an animal-liberation activist imprisoned for an Animal Liberation Front arson that caused roughly $300,000 in damage to a Tandy Leather store. A March 6, 1998 prisoner-support listing recorded him held at the Yuma Unit in Arizona under federal register no. 06329-081.
charges: Arson (Animal Liberation Front action against a Tandy Leather store, ~$300,000 damage)
sentence: Imprisoned for the arson; held at the Yuma Unit, Arizona (per a March 1998 listing)

name: Clinton Colby Ellerman
bio: Clinton Colby Ellerman was a Utah animal-liberation activist imprisoned for releasing mink from the Holt Mink Ranch in an Animal Liberation Front action. A March 6, 1998 prisoner-support listing recorded him held at the Salt Lake County Jail.
charges: Releasing mink from the Holt Mink Ranch (Animal Liberation Front action)
sentence: Imprisoned for the mink release; held at the Salt Lake County Jail (per a March 1998 listing)

name: Steve Hindi
bio: Steve Hindi is an anti-hunting and animal-rights activist (founder of SHARK, Showing Animals Respect and Kindness) who served a six-month sentence for his protest activities against a hunt in Illinois. A March 6, 1998 prisoner-support listing recorded him held at the McHenry County Jail in Woodstock, Illinois.
charges: Protest activities against a hunt in Illinois
sentence: Six-month sentence; held at the McHenry County Jail (per a March 1998 listing)

name: Trev Poulson
bio: Trev Poulson was a Utah animal-liberation activist serving a two-year sentence for an alleged fur-farm mink liberation. A March 6, 1998 prisoner-support listing recorded him held at the Utah State Prison in Draper (Wasatch A West).
sentence: Two-year sentence; held at the Utah State Prison, Draper (per a March 1998 listing)
